info.title: opensdk
info.summary: Generate SDKs from OpenAPI specs through OpenSDK emitter plugins

arguments.name: config
arguments.description: Shorthand: generate everything declared by this config (`opensdk ./sdk.json` == `opensdk run --chain ./sdk.json` for a chain, or `opensdk generate --config <path>` for language sections)

options.name: config
options.description: Path to opensdk config file (default: sdk.json in cwd)

commands.name: parse
commands.description: Parse an OpenAPI spec and output the OpenSDK IR as JSON

options.name: spec
options.description: Path to the OpenAPI spec (yaml/json)

options.name: output
options.description: Write the IR to a file instead of stdout

options.name: sdk-name
options.description: SDK name for the converter

options.name: grouping
options.description: JSON grouping file ({mountRules, operationHints}); overrides the config values

commands.name: xsdk
commands.description: Embed x-sdk SDK docs (signatures, types, usage samples) into an OpenAPI spec — for CI/CD pipelines that ship a docs-ready spec

options.name: spec
options.description: Path to the OpenAPI spec (yaml/json)

options.name: output
options.description: Write the enriched spec to a file instead of stdout

options.name: langs
options.description: Comma-separated SDK language ids (default: all six)

options.name: sdk-name
options.description: SDK name for the converter

options.name: grouping
options.description: JSON grouping file ({mountRules, operationHints}); overrides the config values

commands.name: generate
commands.description: Generate an SDK from an OpenAPI spec (or a pre-parsed IR json) — or a CLI via the go-cli/rust-cli targets. With no --lang, every language declared in sdk.json is generated.

options.name: spec
options.description: Path to the OpenAPI spec (yaml/json) or OpenSDK IR (.json); for the go-cli/rust-cli targets also an OpenCLI document (see `opencli`)

options.name: lang
options.description: Emitter language/alias (go|python|typescript|ruby|java|csharp|rust|...) or a CLI target (go-cli|rust-cli); omit to build every language in sdk.json

options.name: output
options.description: Output directory (single --lang), or the base dir for per-language subfolders (multi-target)

options.name: sdk-name
options.description: SDK name for the converter

options.name: grouping
options.description: JSON grouping file ({mountRules, operationHints}); overrides the config values

options.name: dry-run
options.description: Print the files that would be generated without writing

options.name: no-tests
options.description: Don't emit the generated SDK's self-test suite (sets emitterOptions.<lang>.tests=false)

options.name: merge
options.description: Preserve hand-edits to generated files: 3-way merge them with the new generation instead of overwriting (writes .sdk/base; conflicts get <<<<<<< markers)

options.name: format
options.description: Run the language formatter (rustfmt) over the generated files BEFORE writing them, so .sdk/sdk.lock records the formatted bytes and regeneration stays a byte-stable no-op

commands.name: opencli
commands.description: Write the OpenCLI document a CLI target generates from (the converter step of `generate --lang go-cli|rust-cli`), merging hand-written OpenCLI fragments into it and mounting component CLIs' documents. `generate --spec <that file>` then builds the CLI from it.

options.name: spec
options.description: Path to the OpenAPI spec (yaml/json); an OpenCLI document is taken as is. Default: the config's api

options.name: lang
options.description: The CLI target whose sdk.json section supplies the converter options (default: the first CLI section in the config)

options.name: declare
options.description: Merge a hand-written OpenCLI fragment (repeatable, applied in order): root options/exitCodes/examples/interactive/info.description and x-* keys replace, commands append, a command named like an existing top-level one updates its description/aliases/hidden

options.name: mount
options.description: Mount a component CLI's OpenCLI document as the command NAME (parent/name mounts under parent), after the fragments: a passthrough stub of that name is filled, else the command is appended (repeatable). Reports one line per mount on stderr

options.name: mount-drop
options.description: Drop the component's OPTION from the NAME mount, wherever it appears: for an option the host's recursive options already answer to (repeatable)

options.name: output
options.description: Write the OpenCLI JSON to a file instead of stdout

options.name: sdk-name
options.description: Defaults the CLI name (the section's cliName wins)

commands.name: diff
commands.description: Diff two spec versions by SDK-consumer impact (exit 2 = breaking, 1 = risky, 0 = safe/none)

arguments.name: base
arguments.description: The published/old spec: OpenAPI (yaml/json) or pre-parsed OpenSDK IR (.json)

arguments.name: head
arguments.description: The new spec: OpenAPI (yaml/json) or pre-parsed OpenSDK IR (.json)

options.name: fail-on
options.description: Failure gate: breaking|risky exit per the 0/1/2 table; any also exits 1 on safe-only changes

options.name: json
options.description: Print the machine-readable IrDiff JSON to stdout instead of the grouped report

options.name: sdk-name
options.description: SDK name for the converter (applied to both sides)

options.name: grouping
options.description: JSON grouping file ({mountRules, operationHints}); applied to BOTH sides so remounts never diff as renames

exitCodes.description: No change, or only safe changes (unless --fail-on any)
A risky change, any change under --fail-on any, or an error

commands.name: publish
commands.description: Publish already-generated SDK(s) to their language registries (npm/PyPI/RubyGems/NuGet/Maven; Go = git tag). Run `generate` first.

options.name: lang
options.description: Emitter language/alias; omit to publish every language declared in sdk.json

options.name: output
options.description: Generated SDK dir (single --lang), or the base dir of per-language subfolders

options.name: registry
options.description: Registry URL override (wins over the config publish.registry)

options.name: package-version
options.description: Package version override (wins over the config publish.version). Used where the registry takes no manifest version — the Go git tag. Named --package-version, not --version, which conventionally prints the tool's own version

options.name: tag
options.description: Dist-tag for registries that support one (npm). Omit for the registry default (latest)

options.name: dry-run
options.description: Package only (npm pack / build / gem build / dotnet pack) without pushing

commands.name: run
commands.description: Run a chain.json pipeline: process sources (merge + overlays) then generate every target SDK (add --publish to publish each).

options.name: chain
options.description: Path to the chain file (default: chain.json or .chain/chain.json)

options.name: target
options.description: Only run this target (else every target in the chain)

options.name: source
options.description: Only run targets bound to this source

options.name: publish
options.description: Also publish each generated target to its registry

options.name: dry-run
options.description: Process + print without writing SDKs or pushing

commands.name: init
commands.description: Scaffold a config file (sdk.json by default, or an opensdk.config.mjs plugin bundle)

options.name: project
options.description: Project directory (default: cwd)

options.name: format
options.description: Config format

options.name: dir
options.description: Write the config under a subdir (e.g. .sdk / .chain)

options.name: lang
options.description: Seed this language (default: typescript)

options.name: chain
options.description: Scaffold a chain.json pipeline (sources → targets) instead

exitCodes.description: An error or a usage error
